```hcl
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TERRAGRUNT CONFIGURATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

terraform {
  source = "tfr://crow.infrastructure.immuta.io/iac/storage-database-tools-db/aws?version=1.0.0"
}

# Include all settings from the root terragrunt.hcl file
include {
  path = find_in_parent_folders()
}

generate "backup_provider" {
  path      = "backup-provider.tf"
  if_exists = "overwrite_terragrunt"
  contents  = <<EOF
provider aws {
  alias   = "backup"
  profile = "${local.accounts["platform_management"]["profile"]}"
  region  = "us-east-2"
}
EOF
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Locals are named constants that are reusable within the configuration.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
locals {
  # Automatically load common variables shared across all accounts
  common_vars = read_terragrunt_config(find_in_parent_folders("common.hcl"))

  # Automatically load account-level variables
  account_vars = read_terragrunt_config(find_in_parent_folders("account.hcl"))

  # Automatically load region-level variables
  region_vars = read_terragrunt_config(find_in_parent_folders("region.hcl"))

  # Extract the region and environment for easy access
  aws_region = local.region_vars.locals.aws_region
  env        = local.account_vars.locals.env

  # A local for more convenient access to the accounts map.
  accounts = local.common_vars.locals.accounts

  gs_cidr_blocks = local.common_vars.locals.global_segment_cidrs

  tags = merge(local.common_vars.locals.global_tags, {
    tfpath = "/platform-management/${local.aws_region}/tools-database"
  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MODULE DEPENDENCIES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dependency vpc {
  config_path = "../vpc-cloudwan"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MODULE PARAMETERS
# These are the variables we have to pass in to use the module specified in the terragrunt configuration above
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
inputs = {
  name       = "tools-database"
  pg_version = "17.4"
  env        = "prod"

  private_subnet_ids = [for subnet in dependency.vpc.outputs.vpc.private_subnet_map : subnet.id]
  vpc_id             = dependency.vpc.outputs.vpc.vpc_id

  subnet_group_name_override       = "tools-db"
  dba_security_group_name_override = "tools-db-access"
  security_group_name_override     = "tools-db-trusted-access"

  rds_instance_size            = "db.t4g.small"
  enhanced_monitoring_enabled  = false
  performance_insights_enabled = false
  multi_az                     = false

  allocated_storage = 20
  storage_encrypted = true

  backup_retention_period  = 5
  replica_retention_period = 5
  final_snapshot           = false
  encrypt_replicas         = true

  vault_secret_path = "platform/tools-database"

  trusted_cidr_blocks = [
    local.gs_cidr_blocks["management"]["mgmt"]
  ]

  tags = local.tags
```
}

/*
 * # Postgres DB & Users
 * ## Module Name: postgres-db-users
 * ## This module is to be used to create a single database and an admin and user role associated with said database
 * ## in a pre-existing RDS/postgresql instance
 */

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SET TERRAFORM REQUIREMENTS FOR RUNNING THIS MODULE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

terraform {
  required_version = "~> 1.0"

  required_providers {
    postgresql = {
      source  = "cyrilgdn/postgresql"
      version = "~> 1.21"
    }
    random = {
      version = "~> 3.6.0"
    }
    vault = {
      version = "~> 4.0"
    }
  }
}

locals {
  admin_user    = var.admin_name_override != "" ? var.admin_name_override : "${var.database_name}_admin"
  database_user = var.user_name_override != "" ? var.user_name_override : var.database_name
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE DATABASE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "postgresql_database" "database" {
  count = var.create_database ? 1 : 0

  name       = var.database_name
  owner      = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  encoding   = var.db_encoding
  lc_collate = "C"
  lc_ctype   = "C"

  depends_on = [postgresql_role.admin_user]
}

resource "postgresql_schema" "schema" {
  for_each = toset(var.schema_names)

  name     = each.key
  owner    = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  database = var.database_name

  if_not_exists = true

  depends_on = [postgresql_role.admin_user, postgresql_database.database]
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE ADMIN USER
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "postgresql_role" "admin_user" {
  name        = local.admin_user
  password    = random_password.db_password[local.admin_user].result
  login       = true
  create_role = var.admin_create_role
  roles       = length(var.admin_granted_roles) > 0 ? var.admin_granted_roles : null

  connection_limit = var.admin_conn_limit

  depends_on = [random_password.db_password]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "admin_user_database" {
  database    = var.database_name
  role        = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  object_type = "database"
  privileges  = concat(var.admin_database_privs)

  depends_on = [postgresql_role.admin_user, postgresql_database.database]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "admin_user_table" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database    = var.database_name
  role        = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  schema      = each.key
  object_type = "table"
  privileges  = concat(var.admin_table_privs)

  depends_on = [
    postgresql_role.admin_user,
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "admin_user_function" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database    = var.database_name
  role        = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  schema      = each.key
  object_type = "function"
  privileges  = concat(var.admin_exec_privs)

  depends_on = [
    postgresql_role.admin_user,
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "admin_user_procedure" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database    = var.database_name
  role        = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  schema      = each.key
  object_type = "procedure"
  privileges  = concat(var.admin_exec_privs)

  depends_on = [
    postgresql_role.admin_user,
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE APPLICATION USER
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "postgresql_role" "database_user" {
  name        = local.database_user
  password    = random_password.db_password[local.database_user].result
  login       = true
  create_role = false
  roles       = length(var.user_granted_roles) > 0 ? var.user_granted_roles : null

  connection_limit = var.user_conn_limit

  depends_on = [random_password.db_password]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "database_user_schema" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database = var.database_name
  role = postgresql_role.database_user.name
  schema = each.key
  object_type = "schema"
  privileges = ["USAGE"]

  depends_on = [
    postgresql_role.database_user,
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "database_user" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database    = var.database_name
  role        = postgresql_role.database_user.name
  schema      = each.key
  object_type = "table"
  privileges  = concat(var.user_privs)

  depends_on = [
    postgresql_role.database_user,
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "database_user_function" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database    = var.database_name
  role        = postgresql_role.database_user.name
  schema      = each.key
  object_type = "function"
  privileges  = ["EXECUTE"]

  depends_on = [
    postgresql_role.database_user,
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "database_user_sequence" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database    = var.database_name
  role        = postgresql_role.database_user.name
  schema      = each.key
  object_type = "sequence"
  privileges  = ["USAGE"]

  depends_on = [
    postgresql_role.database_user,
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_default_privileges" "database_user_table" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database = var.database_name
  role     = postgresql_role.database_user.name
  schema   = each.key

  owner       = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  object_type = "table"
  privileges  = concat(var.user_privs)
  depends_on = [
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_role.admin_user,
    postgresql_role.database_user,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_default_privileges" "database_user_function" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database = var.database_name
  role     = postgresql_role.database_user.name
  schema   = each.key

  owner       = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  object_type = "function"
  privileges  = ["EXECUTE"]
  depends_on = [
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_role.admin_user,
    postgresql_role.database_user,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

resource "postgresql_default_privileges" "database_user_sequence" {
  for_each = postgresql_schema.schema

  database = var.database_name
  role     = postgresql_role.database_user.name
  schema   = each.key

  owner       = postgresql_role.admin_user.name
  object_type = "sequence"
  privileges  = ["USAGE"]
  depends_on = [
    postgresql_database.database,
    postgresql_role.admin_user,
    postgresql_role.database_user,
    postgresql_schema.schema
  ]
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GENERATE PASSWORDS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "random_password" "db_password" {
  for_each = toset([local.admin_user, local.database_user])

  length      = var.password_settings.length
  lower       = var.password_settings.lowercase
  min_lower   = var.password_settings.min_lower
  min_numeric = var.password_settings.min_numeric
  min_special = var.password_settings.min_special
  min_upper   = var.password_settings.min_upper
  numeric          = var.password_settings.numeric
  override_special = var.password_settings.override_special
  special          = var.password_settings.special
  upper            = var.password_settings.upper

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [
      length,
      lower,
      min_lower,
      min_numeric,
      min_special,
      min_upper,
      numeric,
      override_special,
      special,
      upper
    ]
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STORE DB CREDENTIALS IN VAULT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "vault_kv_secret_v2" "db_users" {
  for_each = var.create_vault_secret ? random_password.db_password : {}

  mount               = var.vault_mount
  name                = "${var.vault_path}/${each.key}"
  cas                 = 1
  delete_all_versions = false
  data_json = jsonencode(
    {
      user = each.key
      pass = random_password.db_password[each.key].result
    }
  )
  custom_metadata {
    data = {
      tags = jsonencode(var.tags)
    }
  }
}
